cohort: The study participants were pregnant women aged 18 to 45 years with uncomplicated full-term pregnancies.
finding: The prevalence of low CPR was 16.4 percent, and normal CPR values measured within a week before birth were found to be a good indicator of normal perinatal outcomes.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken within a week before birth, during the period of July to December 2023.
